caption:
Don't just subtract. Divide the changes.

When x jumps by 3, then 4, then 5, the rate is change in y ÷ change in x: −24 ÷ 3 = −8 gallons per minute.

Save this for your next table question.
tiktok_caption: Rate of change from a table: divide, don't just subtract.

youtube.title: Rate of Change From a Table (Uneven x Steps)
youtube.description: Rate of change is change in y divided by change in x. Example: a tank goes from 184 to 160 gallons in 3 minutes, so it drains 8 gallons per minute.
